title: A builder cannot restore a mutation-test file from another commit
why: Step builder-edits-mutation-tests is done but does not cover these forms, and #1675 (builders may only add to hooks/mutate_guard.py) closed unmerged.
note: Orphan from the coordinator transcript reconcile, 10:26 CST Nov 10 (coordinator 19:56 CST Nov 7): refuse a builder's `git checkout <sha> -- hooks/mutate_*.py`, `git restore --source`, and a directory pathspec that holds a mutation-test path. Check main's guard first; a form main already refuses needs no change. Held by the freeze (owner 09:18 CST Nov 10).
